learning_outcomes.text: Articulate the strategic role of the chief executive distinct from operational management
Set and communicate a clear enterprise strategy and strategic priorities
Allocate capital and attention across the portfolio to create value
Build and lead a top team that executes the strategy
Read the external environment and reposition the enterprise when it shifts
Hold the organisation accountable for strategic outcomes without micromanaging

integrative_case: A long-standing manufacturer's core market is shrinking while a new CEO inherits a loyal but operationally focused top team: set three enterprise priorities, reallocate capital away from the declining core, reshape the executive team, and present the strategy to a sceptical board.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
